prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver ONE complete polished wide 16:9 title illustration for the game THE NULL LINE.
These three supplied images are CHARACTER AND PAINTING STYLE references, not an editing target or a layout to copy. Image 1: use only TOP MIDDLE mechanic design, mustard yellow hood with narrow horizontal black face void and one amber glowing eye, olive clothes, cream work apron, brown mittens, portable circular saw. Image 2: use only TOP MIDDLE signal technician design, petrol blue hood and cloak edged ivory, black face void with one cyan eye, copper ear cups and compact radio antenna pack. Image 3: use only TOP LEFT carrier design, olive hooded cloak, ivory scarf, one pale green yellow eye in black face void, mustard backpack with three cylindrical battery caps and brown red straps. Exactly THREE small protagonists, retain simple rounded squat cloak silhouettes and tiny stubby feet, no human anatomy or long limbs. No extra people.
Strict visual style: hand-drawn illustrated indie game art consistent with these references. Bold dark brown contours throughout characters AND architecture; deliberately simplified stylized large shapes, broad two-tone painted shadows, limited paper-like painterly grain. Entire environment must be designed in the same stylized language as characters. NO realistic station or photoreal textures, no reflective realistic wet paving, no photography, no realistic 3D, no ordinary Korean/Japanese subway.
World rules: An authoritarian automated city continues its routine in the absence of its citizens. The protagonists' civic records have been erased; machines now classify them as waste. Working civic cameras, cleaners, processing rails and bureaucratic machinery feel indifferent, not demonic. The city is functional and orderly yet deeply wrong. Dystopian industrial fairy-tale scale and invented municipal machinery, oppressive monumental geometry. No biological experiments, no human-machine transformation, no zombies, no gore, no giant humanoid monster, no occult fantasy, no neon cyberpunk. No medieval ruins.
Palette family: deep petrol and charcoal, muted olive, dirty ivory, mustard yellow, copper brown, small cyan and amber lamps, occasional institutional red. Readable silhouettes, rich controlled contrast. Title exact and only text: "THE NULL LINE". Beautiful large industrial condensed ivory lettering, exact spelling, extremely legible. THE may be small above NULL LINE. No subtitles, slogans, readable sign text, fake writing, menu buttons or watermarks. These are proposed visual directions, not new canon.
CANDIDATE C — THE CITY THAT STILL WATCHES.
A restrained, eerie, graphic title image with expansive dark negative space. An invented deserted municipal district seen from an elevated three-quarter angle, like a beautiful ominous illustrated miniature city. Tall chunky rounded residential blocks form a deep canyon, connected by thick service pipes and elevated automated cargo tracks. Repeated identical ivory windows stay lit; not a single resident. No ruined apocalypse: unoccupied orderly streets, functional street lamps, a few very small nonhumanoid disk-shaped cleaner robots dutifully polishing already empty lanes.
The dominant visual is an enormous utilitarian surveillance apparatus built into a blank administrative tower on the RIGHT: one immense circular red scanning lens in a heavy asymmetrical ivory and olive box housing, with side motors and bundled conduits, aimed down toward the street. Clearly municipal hardware with industrial joints, NOT a creature, face, deity or occult eye. Its thin red scan plane travels through the empty street, interrupted only by the three unregistered protagonists. Use one optic, no rows of threatening eyes.
The three exact reference heroes appear at LOWER RIGHT, small but readable, about 17-22 percent image height, standing together on an elevated service stair landing above the deserted lane. Stagger their heights along the stairs instead of putting them in a straight lineup: mustard mechanic on lower step in front, blue signal technician on middle step looking up at the lens with cyan eye visible in profile, olive battery carrier on top step partially turned with a readable pale eye and backpack. Strong individual silhouettes and consistent scale/perspective. Tiny amber and cyan character glows are the only warm alive points against the immense indifferent city.
LEFT HALF is mostly deep desaturated petrol haze and large simplified building shadow planes, with room for a very strong beautiful ivory title "THE NULL LINE" at upper/middle LEFT. Modest THE above big NULL LINE. Beneath title, a single thin schematic transit line ending abruptly at a hollow circle, no other marks or text. Compose like exceptional illustrated indie game cover art: striking imbalance, emptiness, oppressive scale, limited color, strong negative shapes. Muted ivory city edges and faded olive against near black petrol; red lens as a concentrated warning. Confident thick contour ink and broad painted two-tone shapes like character refs throughout. Do NOT render a realistic city or subway, no tiled platforms, no photoreal wet surfaces, no neon skyscrapers, no crowds, no humanoid background robots. Less clutter than an industrial factory, more quiet dread and distinct graphic identity.
